subject: selectInput for filenames in the server returns error: "subscript out of bound"

messages.author: 6df9390b006290b3
messages.subject: selectInput for filenames in the server returns error: "subscript out of bound"
parts:
Hi,

I have been banging my head for a long time with this. Am new to shiny. I am trying to get a list of csv files to show in a dropbox for user selection. The folder where those files are located is in the shiny hosting machine. When I run my app from the host machine (Linux) directly, it runs just fine. But when I run it from a client machine (Windows 7) I get a "subscript out of bounds" error. Could anybody tell me what I am doing wrong? This should be a really simple thing, but it's taking me too long to figure it out.

#server.R:

library(shiny)

filenames<-list.files(path="/L123/GeneNetwork/",pattern="\\.csv$")

shinyServer(function(input,output){
     output$choose_dataset<-renderUI({
      selectInput("dataset","Data set",as.list(filenames))
   })
})


#ui.R:
library(shiny)
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel(
    "File Selection"
  ),
  sidebarPanel(
    uiOutput("choose_dataset")
  ),
  mainPanel(
  )
)) 

Any help is deeply appreciated.

PD
